description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger Your needle crosses zero.

Duration 1 round

The turn carries you. You gain a +1 status bonus to spell attack rolls and to your spell DCs for 1 round. This triggers on the first crossing of each encounter only, whichever direction it goes.

cinderfall.incomplete: `BLOOMROT-NULL` — there is no "the needle crossed zero" event on the actor to trigger from. Even setting that aside, this is an automatic/passive trigger (not a player-clicked action), so the real P5 pattern (`selfEffect` fired by using an action, as in Rage) doesn't apply either — there is no button-press to hang `selfEffect` off of. `momentum-effect.json`'s real rules are consequently orphaned data with no path to ever apply.
